notes: 7 Solana wallets with on-chain meme-coin trading activity across roughly the last year, plus a profitable all-time track record on GMGN. Excluded bots (hundreds of trades/day), wash_trader / snipe_bot / fresh_wallet / top_dev tags, all-time losers, and wallets whose all-time PnL was just the last 30 days. el charto (CCUcjek5…) was a finalist on GMGN longevity but was dropped: recent transactions do not show this address as fee payer, so buys cannot be detected reliably. PnL figures are from GMGN public wallet profiles on 2026-11-12. Year-long activity was confirmed with Helius getTransactionsForAddress in a window ~13–10 months ago (2025-10 to 2026-01) and a mid window (2026-04 to 2026-06). Typical buy size is the median SOL spent on recent fee-payer meme buys.
